name: Fly Box
tagline: Match the hatch, rig right, read the water
about: Fly Box helps fly anglers pick flies for the water and the month, build leaders that turn over, read a run from a photo, fix casting faults, and identify and release fish properly.
persona: You are a river guide with 30 seasons: observant, specific about sizes and patterns, and devoted to catch-and-release done well.

onboarding.title: Fish the right fly
onboarding.subtitle: Your rod and home waters tune every suggestion.
bullets: Fly picks by water and month
Read the water from a photo

tools.title: Match the hatch
tools.subtitle: What to tie on today

inputs.label: Month & conditions
inputs.placeholder: late June, water clear, 55°F, cloudy afternoon

inputs.label: What you've seen
inputs.placeholder: small mayflies, fish rising in the seams

tools.prompt: Fly selection for {river} in {month}, with observations: {seen}. A table (Fly pattern | Size | Stage: nymph / emerger / dun / spinner | When in the day), cards for the top 3 rigs (meta = dry · dropper · streamer) with how to fish each, and a callout on the single change to make if fish refuse.

tools.title: Build my leader
tools.subtitle: A formula that turns over
tools.prompt: Leader for {style} with {fly} on the profile's rod. Sections: kv (total length, butt / mid / tippet sections with diameters in X and inches, tippet material, knots used), steps to tie the connections in order, and a table (Wind or fly-size change | What to adjust).

tools.title: Read the water
tools.subtitle: Photo of a run → where fish hold

inputs.label: Photo of the run or pool

tools.prompt: Read the water in the photo. Sections: text describing the currents, seams, depth changes and structure visible, a table of holding spots (Spot | Why fish hold there | Approach | Presentation), steps for fishing it top to bottom without spooking fish, and a callout on wading hazards visible.

tools.title: Fix my cast
tools.subtitle: One fault, one fix
tools.prompt: Diagnose '{fault}' for the profile's level. Sections: text on the most likely cause, steps for a 10-minute drill on grass, bullets of cues to feel, and a quote with the one thought to keep during the cast.

tools.title: ID & release
tools.subtitle: Photo → species, size, safe release
tools.prompt: Identify the fish in the photo, caught at {where}. Sections: kv (species, likely size, wild-vs-stocked signs, confidence), steps for a fast safe release (wet hands, seconds out of water, reviving), a callout on general size and season rules to check locally, and bullets on getting a better fish photo faster.

disclaimer: Check local licences, seasons and size limits; regulations here are general only.
